description: This script is a command-line utility written in JavaScript (Node.js) for managing GitHub security advisories via the GitHub CLI. It facilitates updating advisory details including severity, description, vulnerable package versions, and CVSS scores, by parsing command-line arguments, interacting with GitHub API, and managing temporary JSON payloads.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Logs an error message and exits the process.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into an object.

methods.name: runGh
methods.description: Runs the 'gh' CLI command with specified arguments and returns its output.

methods.name: deriveRepoFromOrigin
methods.description: Extracts GitHub repository info from git remote origin URL.

methods.name: parseGhsaId
methods.description: Extracts the GHSA ID from the provided string.

methods.name: writeTempJson
methods.description: Writes the given JSON data to a temporary file and returns its path.
